status: Closed — active-claim-safe blocked-lifecycle bridge is present and its governed record-commit regression passes; broader cross-surface governance coverage remains follow-up
finding: `tasks block` can leave one staged ledger plus block-event pair for each of several parked cards. While an unrelated framework task has an active claim, `git record-commit` rejects even one exact parked-card pair as out-of-claim staging. Releasing the active recovery task just to persist those records can make its uncommitted source WIP unowned again, creating a lifecycle serialization deadlock.
expectedBehavior: A narrow record-only path must persist exactly one complete `blocked`/`released` task's ledger and matching block event while another framework claim remains active. It must reject mixed tasks, source, evidence, close/release records, incomplete pairs, and any mutation of the active task's source bundle.
evidenceOrRepro: Historical reproduction: ATM-GOV-0266 recovery after parking TASK-SKL-0029, ATM-GOV-0248, and ATM-GOV-0240. After exact index re-batching, `node atm.mjs git record-commit --actor claude-004-skl-0029-captain ...` failed with `ATM_GIT_COMMIT_FRAMEWORK_STAGING_AMBIGUOUS`; its `outOfScopeStagedFiles` was the exact TASK-SKL-0029 ledger/block pair because ATM-GOV-0266 remained active. Current source contains the narrow record-only block-lifecycle bridge in `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/record-only-block-lifecycle-bridge.ts`; `tests/cli/git-record-commit.test.ts` passes the bridge classifier, governed success path, mixed-task rejection, incomplete-pair rejection, and active-claim source isolation checks.
followUp: ATM-GOV-0266 owns the repair: add an active-claim-safe blocked lifecycle record bridge in git-governance plus focused `git-record-commit` regressions. Verify one pair succeeds without staging active-claim source and all non-block/mixed-task payloads fail closed.
